title: Atoms, elements and compounds
keyIdea: An element has only one type of atom. A compound has two or more elements chemically joined.

kid: Atoms are the smallest bits of an element. There are about 118 elements. Oxygen, iron and carbon are three of them. Each element has its own kind of atom and a short symbol: O for oxygen, Fe for iron.
A compound forms when atoms of different elements join. Water, H₂O, is a compound. Each water particle has two hydrogen atoms joined to one oxygen atom.
adult: An atom has a tiny central nucleus, made of protons and neutrons. Electrons are arranged in shells around it. The number of protons decides which element the atom is.

Compounds can behave very differently from their elements. Sodium is a reactive metal and chlorine is a toxic gas. Together they make sodium chloride, which is table salt. A formula like CO₂ gives the ratio of atoms: one carbon to two oxygen.

familyTip: Read the ingredients on a food or cleaning label. Which names are elements and which are compounds?

practice.prompt: Which of these is an element?
practice.hint: Look for only one kind of atom.
practice.explain: O₂ has only oxygen atoms, so it's an element, even though the atoms are joined in pairs.

practice.prompt: How many atoms are in {n} molecules of water, H₂O?
What decides which element an atom is?
practice.explain: The number of protons is the atomic number, and it decides the element.

practice.prompt: How many hydrogen atoms are in {n} molecules of methane, CH₄?
Sodium is a reactive metal and chlorine is a toxic gas. What is sodium chloride like?
choices: A safe white solid: table salt
A mixture you can separate with a magnet
practice.explain: Sodium chloride is table salt. Its properties are completely different from its elements.

pool.prompt: How many atoms in total are in {n} molecules of carbon dioxide, CO₂?
How many oxygen atoms are in {n} molecules of oxygen, O₂?

pool.explain: CO₂ has carbon and oxygen joined together.

pool.prompt: What is the symbol for iron?
pool.hint: It comes from the Latin word ferrum.
pool.explain: Fe. (I is iodine and Ir is iridium.)

pool.prompt: Where are the protons and neutrons in an atom?
pool.explain: Protons and neutrons are in the nucleus; electrons are in shells.

pool.prompt: Which statement about water, H₂O, is true?
choices: Each molecule has 2 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom
It is a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen
pool.explain: H₂O: 2 hydrogen and 1 oxygen, chemically joined, so it's a compound.

pool.prompt: What is the difference between a carbon atom and the element carbon?
choices: An atom is one particle; the element is a substance made only of carbon atoms
There is no difference at all
The element contains other atoms too
pool.hint: One particle, or a lot of them?
pool.explain: An element is made of many atoms, all of the same type.

visual.caption: Build an atom. The number of protons decides the element.
